cohort: 554 premature infants born in southern Iran between March 21, 2019, and March 19, 2020.
finding: Premature birth was associated with various sociodemographic and medical factors, including unwanted pregnancy, low maternal hemoglobin, high maternal BMI, pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, opium use in the family, history of cesarean section, low family income, low parental education, and non-professional parental occupations.
